# MEDIA MANIFEST — OpenEdit pipeline test media (generated by media-studio agent)

All takes: 1920x1080 @ 30fps, H.264 (libx264, preset fast, crf 23, yuv420p), AAC 128k @ 44100 Hz. 
Speech: espeak-ng (en-us, -a 160, wpm per take), spoken verbatim including um/uh fillers. 
Audio construction: 1.2s leading silence + phrase wavs separated by 0.7s silence gaps (concat, lossless `-c copy`; 
silence generated with anullsrc at 22050 Hz mono to match espeak-ng's native output rate). 
Muxed with `-shortest`; visual duration = audio duration + 1.0s. All timestamps below are exact build offsets (seconds).
